mechanism: Perphenazine may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing letrozole metabolism competition and altering aromatase inhibitor efficacy; additive CNS depression and orthostatic hypotension risk.
action: Monitor for reduced letrozole efficacy and increased CNS adverse effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with minimal CYP450 interactions if possible, and assess blood pressure regularly.
